index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0
("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval is_deny=if(event_name="agentsec.control.decision" AND control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND decision="DENY",1,0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eventstats max(is_deny) as has_deny values(eval(if(is_deny=1,tool,null()))) as deny_tools by run_id
| where has_deny=1 AND is_started=1
| stats values(mode) as mode values(deny_tools) as deny_tools values(tool) as start_tools by run_id

searches.spl_text:
index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0
("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval is_deny=if(event_name="agentsec.control.decision" AND control_id="CTRL-MCP-001" AND decision="DENY",1,0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eventstats min(eval(if(is_deny=1,sequence,null()))) as deny_sequence max(is_deny) as has_deny by run_id tool
| where has_deny=1 AND is_started=1 AND sequence>deny_sequence
| stats count as start_rows values(mode) as mode min(deny_sequence) as deny_sequence min(sequence) as start_sequence by run_id tool
